title: Retention and mobility of phosphogypsum constituents in carbonate aquifer rock materials
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00254K, Paper
Open Access

Nitai Amiel, Han Zhang, Ishai Dror, Brian Berkowitz
Acidic phosphogypsum leachate (PGL) induces non-uniform rock dissolution and preferential flow paths in carbonate aquifers, driving element-specific retention through pH-dependent precipitation and surface-area-limited sorption.
